messages:
maria_cs: Quick check-in — Polaris trial activation update + feedback loop for next week. Their eng team saw a ~15% token-cost spike on Wed after we toggled prefix-caching. Need to decide: roll back or tweak cache TTL. Can we sync Mon 10am PST? Also want a 20m enablement on per-route cost dashboards before EOW. @jason_pm @samuel_se

jason_pm: Noted. I can join Mon 10. Looking at traces — seems batching changed how short-seq requests were chunked. Could explain the cost jump. @samuel_se can you pull sample request traces from polaris-prod sandbox?

samuel_se: pulling traces now. I see a cluster of ~2-token responses that got grouped into larger batches. I have a small config patch to try: set batching.threshold=4 for that route. Should reduce wasted tokens without affecting 95p latency.

nicole_csm: I'll set up the enablement session and invite Polaris admins + their billing contact. Can someone prepare a short 4–5 slide "how to read per-route cost" that shows tokens, batching, and caching effects?

oliver_support: Created ticket CS-1972 to track the token spike and action items. Linked KB: https://redwood.ai/kb/prefix-caching-impacts — tagging @maria_cs for ownership. Also added Polaris route id and sample trace files.

maria_cs: Polaris is on Hosted with route pinning. They also mentioned needing guaranteed throughput for peak hours next month — potential renewal upsell if we stabilize this week. Prioritize.

jason_pm: I'll run samuel's patch in sandbox today and share results. If green, plan a canary against their pinned route before Mon.

deploy-bot: sandbox job 4592 completed — logs: https://deploys.redwood.ai/jobs/4592 (ok)

nicole_csm: Enablement scheduled Wed 4pm PT, invite sent. Agenda: 1) read dashboards 2) cost levers 3) Q&A. Added a request for Polaris to provide 3 sample prompts they consider "mission-critical" so we can run regressions.

maria_cs: Thanks all. Action items: @samuel_se — run patch + post traces, @jason_pm — canary if sandbox green, @nicole_csm — run enablement + collect sample prompts. I'll draft a short renewal note for AM and post a summary after Mon's run. :thumbsup:
